name: Castle Farm Fresh Produce
tradingEvidence: Public website with an active online shop listing produce boxes, fruit, vegetables, butchery and grocery categories with prices (Medium Mixed Box £45 on 26 July 2026); Northern Ireland home-delivery information and a published order-minimum policy; site captured during concept research on 23 July 2026.
digitalPresence: Shopify e-commerce site with slideshow homepage, newsletter sign-up lightbox and cookie banner on arrival. Category navigation, box deals, cart and checkout are live. Re-checked 26 July 2026: product listings and delivery copy remain current. The captured before still (23 July 2026) shows the newsletter request competing with the farm content on first arrival — the honest case is first-screen clarity and shop journey, not a rebuild.
designTask: Produce-led farm shop: calmer first arrival, one clear shop action, and weekly box promise on the opening screen.
caveats: Working online shop with checkout; the concept must argue for clarity and journey, not replacing a functioning store.
notes: Predates the verification pipeline; before/after media captured 23 July 2026. Verification record drafted 26 July 2026 during publication review. Awaiting merge into research/pipeline/verifications.json, publication.json and publicTransformationSlugs.
